newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Zambia's 3-month T-bill rate continues sliding.
newsitem.headline: Zambia's 3-month T-bill rate continues sliding.

text.p: Zambia's central bank said on Monday that it sold three-month treasury bills at an average discount rate of 24.7919 percent at its latest auction.
The bank said it sold six billion of the 91-day treasury bills on tender received at last Thursday's weekly auction. The discount rate was slightly down from the previous week's 25.0758 percent.
It said five billion of the 28-day treasury bills were sold at an average discount rate of 21.3732, down from the previous week's 22.2773 percent.
The bank sold four billion six-month treasury bills at an average discount rate of 23.6047 percent, down from 24.1517 percent the previous week.
